from collections import deque
H = [(15,51),(15,48),(15,45),(15,42),(15,39),(15,21),(15,18),(15,15),(15,12),(15,9),
     (45,51),(45,48),(45,45),(45,42),(45,39),(45,21),(45,18),(45,15),(45,12),(45,9)]
V = [(9,15),(12,15),(15,15),(18,15),(21,15),(39,15),(42,15),(45,15),(48,15),(51,15),
     (9,45),(12,45),(15,45),(18,45),(21,45),(39,45),(42,45),(45,45),(48,45),(51,45)]
Hi = {c:i for i,c in enumerate(H)}; Vi = {c:i for i,c in enumerate(V)}
def step(pos, which, d):
    idx = (Hi if which=='H' else Vi).get(pos)
    if idx is None: return pos
    return (H if which=='H' else V)[(idx+d)%20]
start = ((15,39),(51,15))
goalY, goalO = (45,45),(45,51)
acts = [('HF',lambda y,o:(step(y,'H',1),step(o,'H',1))),
        ('HR',lambda y,o:(step(y,'H',-1),step(o,'H',-1))),
        ('VF',lambda y,o:(step(y,'V',1),step(o,'V',1))),
        ('VR',lambda y,o:(step(y,'V',-1),step(o,'V',-1)))]
q = deque([start]); prev = {start:(None,None)}
while q:
    s = q.popleft()
    if s[0]==goalY and s[1]==goalO: break
    for name,f in acts:
        ns = f(*s)
        if ns not in prev:
            prev[ns]=(s,name); q.append(ns)
s=(goalY,goalO)
path=[]
while prev[s][0] is not None:
    path.append(prev[s][1]); s=prev[s][0]
path.reverse()
print("path:", ''.join(path), "len", len(path))

clicks = {'HF':(45,6),'HR':(15,55),'VF':(25,45),'VR':(6,15)}
seq = [{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c} for r,c in (clicks[p] for p in path)]
res = action(seq)
print("done", last_action_result.get('board_changed'), last_action_result.get('level_completed'), last_action_result.get('done'))
